The stadium background is filled with fans in yellow shirts under bright floodlights. (2) The group transitions into a formal lineup for a photo opportunity. A baseball player in a red, black, and white uniform joins them, holding a glove. The women pose with finger-heart gestures and bright smiles towards a group of photographers. Staff members with cameras and black 'NOCTA' t-shirts are seen in the foreground and background as the player exits the frame.
